supersedes: covid_transport_fit_01_* — same scenario, base_overrides and observation structure verbatim; the arm axis is now Theta over a declared candidate grid instead of the transport solver.
description: Post-airflow-repair Theta refit, held-out half: Greg Mortimer hygiene_cycle scored at the Theta the DP grid selects, plus its half-decade neighbours as sensitivity (merge_held_out semantics). Identical cell shape to TRANSPORT-FIT-01's GM design — the rescore's hygiene_cycle arm verbatim under the shipped post-B1-B3 stack; Theta is the only axis. covid.H1 (128/217 positive share), covid.H2 (0.8125 asymptomatic share), covid.H3 placement, takeoff — the same held-out report merge_held_out produces; no held-out quantity feeds back into candidate selection.
split_role_note: Held-out by the fixed split (docs/proposals/covid_trajectory_fit_spec.md §2). This design measures the transport-solver sensitivity of the held-out score; nothing in it may feed a parameter choice.

cell_conditioning.note: As-declared replay of the greg_mortimer_2020 scenario record: explicit seed is one passenger at epoch 0 with infection_age_days 0.0, scheduled SOP-017 cabin isolation voyage day 8 -> end_day 27, single ship-wide testing campaign voyage day 20, molecular_ascertainment_start_day 20, boarding channel off, platform expedition_cruise_450 declared not fitted. Scored channels are the rescore's own: campaign positives vs 128/217 (H1), asymptomatic share vs 0.8125 (H2), takeoff (>=10 recorded onsets).
cell_conditioning.theta: 2.37e11 — the COVID-GM-RESCORE-02 anchor row only. The v13 conditioning lattice (1e11|2.37e11|1e12) is not re-enumerated: this design asks how the transported-dose field moves the held-out score at the DP-conditioned operating point, not where on a Θ lattice it lands.

arms.note: Single arm so empty overrides per the arm grammar — the whole shipped post-repair stack runs: near_field two_box (204 m3/h, ratio 0.43), pathogen_pool_transport airflow, room_air_removal first_order ambient_on, duty0_terminal_mode extract, ambient openings + envelope/exhaust sinks. Resolved engine auditable via delivery.transport_engine_resolved == ContamTransportEngine.

cells_note: 1 arm x 12 Theta candidates x 50 seeds = 600 cells. Same seed series as TF-01/RI-01 so every cell pairs seed-for-seed with the repair-isolation baseline arm. Theta grid: the currently fitted 7.9e6 plus the v5/v6 first-look half-decade surface 1e7..1e12; a winner at either end is boundary-pinned by convention.
